purpose: Freeze the exact effective execution-code set for the artifact-recovery successor Full144 run (restart from Unit 1). The ONLY execution-code change vs the corrected set is the generalized evidence-driven R4-E recovery binding in the qualified runner plus the generalized recovery consumed-record in the driver.
aggregate_hash_method: SHA-256 over the LF-joined sorted lines '<sha256>  <path>', paths sorted lexicographically, one trailing LF (identical to the predecessor method; hashes are of git-blob LF-normalized bytes).

members.role: Full144 execution driver (additive refreeze: run root overridable via R4_FULL144_RUN_ROOT; generalized evidence-driven recovery consumed record)
Frozen Full144 population/order/binding authority used by the driver (dead RECOVERY_UNIT constant removed)
CORRECTED qualified runner: evidence-driven pin-selected R4-E recovery binding replacing the N12-only pylint special case; all other behavioural semantics unchanged
Successor D7 install-route closure projection (reuses frozen R3 closure; generic route-authority rule; R4-B parser untouched)

exclusion_rule: Unchanged modules required by the execution path are already frozen by git blobs and covered by the frozen-invariance audit; only modules whose changed behaviour is required by the artifact-recovery path are members.
